accepted_fix: Keep unexpected endpoint errors fatal and source-stamped, but isolate receive/packet/send failure per already-readable endpoint so valid sibling evidence and one ACK remain processable under same dynamic absolute deadline. Retain earlier source tightening, validation, one-shot ACKs, bounded diagnostics and no normal close relaxation.

findings.proof_limits: Exact AST-extracted production Execution.monitor/pump/fail, FailurePool, observed_failure and (second proof) Channel.receive. Fake readiness, sockets, clocks, direct reports, process groups, signals and absence. Persistent endpoint failure is an explicit fixture condition; no claim it caused the retained production transport failure. This is deterministic control-flow starvation of an endpoint already reported readable, not a queued-delivery guarantee.
